content:
SLIDES:
1. 40 people saw the odd email. Zero reported it.
2. Bystander effect: everyone assumes someone else will act.
3. Result: one phishing email stays live for days.
4. Reporting takes seconds. Not reporting can take weeks to fix.
5. Use the report button. Even if you're not sure.
6. Reporting isn't snitching. It's protecting your team.
7. Leaders: thank reporters out loud.
8. Be the one who reports. Share this.

CAPTION:
Silence helps attackers. If something looks off, report it, even if you think others already did. Fast reports turn one victim into zero. Does your workplace make reporting easy? #ReportPhishing #SecurityCulture #CyberAwareness
